label: Volt & Grove
description: Deep electric green with a marigold accent on a light page. Built for electric mobility — e-rickshaw and EV dealerships, charging and battery businesses, green transport and last-mile fleets.
notes:
Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables.

WHY NOT 'octane': the automotive default is a dark motorsport palette built for performance detailing studios. An e-rickshaw dealership sells a livelihood, not a weekend car — the buyer is comparing EMI amounts and running costs, often on a cheap phone in daylight. A light page reads better in those conditions and a green primary carries the electric/eco meaning the product actually has. Marigold accent keeps it warm and local rather than corporate.

FONTS ARE LOAD-BEARING HERE: Poppins and Mukta both ship Devanagari as well as Latin, and both serve weights 400-700. Sites in this category carry a lot of Hindi — services, FAQs, CTAs — and the usual Inter/Space Grotesk pairing has no Devanagari at all, so every Hindi line would silently fall back to a system font and look broken next to the English. Do not swap either font for a Latin-only family without checking the Devanagari subset first.
